summaries.en: The article promotes a white paper arguing that the AI governance debate presents a false choice between over-regulation and no regulation. The content is incomplete, but the key takeaway is a call for a balanced, practical approach rather than extreme positions.

items.title: Google Wallet makes TSA PreCheck Touchless ID available for more travelers
items.content: Google Wallet is the first digital wallet partnering with the TSA to help more travelers move through airport security with TSA PreCheck Touchless ID.
items.contentSnippet: Google Wallet is the first digital wallet partnering with the TSA to help more travelers move through airport security with TSA PreCheck Touchless ID.

summaries.zh: Google Wallet成为首个与美国运输安全管理局（TSA）合作的数字钱包，使更多旅客能够使用TSA PreCheck无接触ID功能，更便捷地通过机场安检。
summaries.en: Google Wallet has become the first digital wallet to partner with the TSA, expanding access to TSA PreCheck Touchless ID. This feature allows travelers to move through airport security more efficiently using biometric verification, without needing to present a physical ID or boarding pass.

summaries.en: YouTube is introducing new insights tools at Cannes Lions 2026 to enhance creator partnerships and improve ad campaigns. These tools aim to provide deeper data and analytics, helping marketers optimize their strategies. The updates are designed to strengthen creative campaigns by offering more actionable insights. The announcement highlights YouTube's commitment to supporting advertisers and creators through innovative solutions. The tools are expected to be a key focus at the event, showcasing YouTube's advancements in advertising technology.
